name: Checkbox
summary: Selects an item, or agrees to something, as part of a choice applied by another action, at three sizes, with a description line, a mixed state for a parent of partly checked children and an invalid state with its fix. Not for a setting that applies at once (use Switch), or for one of several exclusive options (use a radio group). Several related boxes go in a CheckboxGroup, which names them with a legend.
a11y: A native checkbox inside its `label`, so the whole row is the target (44 px at normal, 48 at l; s is a dense 36 px exception). With `labelHidden` the label stays as the accessible name. Mixed sets the native `indeterminate`, so it reads as "mixed"; the dash and the filled box carry it, not colour alone. The description and error are linked with `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid`. Forced colours keep the box, the tick and the dash.

keys.action: checks or unchecks; a mixed box becomes checked

props.name: label
props.description: What checking it selects or agrees to. Also the accessible name when `labelHidden`.

props.name: checked
props.description: `'mixed'` for a parent whose children are partly checked: it shows a dash and reads as "mixed".

props.name: onChange
props.description: The new state; nothing is saved by checking alone. A mixed box becomes checked.

props.name: description
props.description: One short line under the label: what checking it means or includes.

props.name: error
props.description: What's wrong and how to fix it, e.g. a required agreement left unchecked. Marks it invalid.

props.name: size
props.description: s (16 px box, 36 px row) for dense lists and tables; normal (20 px, 44 px) by default; l (24 px, 48 px) for touch-first forms.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Shows only the box, where its position already says what it selects (a row's or a block's own box).

props.name: disabled
props.description: It can't change here. Prefer saying why nearby.
